meeting_point: Oakhurst Park & Ride / Oakhurst Branch Library – 49044 Civic Cir, Oakhurst, CA 93644
description:
Join Good Trip Adventures for an awe-inspiring small-group exploration of the iconic Yosemite Valley. Immerse yourself in the splendor of towering cliffs, majestic waterfalls, and the lush landscapes that make Yosemite a natural wonder.

Our seasoned guides will immerse you in Yosemite’s natural wonders, sharing the parks' formation story, indigenous cultures, historical significance, and insights into its diverse flora and fauna.
itinerary: We’ll head into the park, stopping along the way to take in views of the iconic rock formations, spot wildlife, and learn about the park’s natural and human history. Stops today include Wawona, the Pohono Trail by Tunnel View, Bridalveil Falls, Cook’s Meadow, Mirror Lake, Curry Village, Yosemite Falls, and El Capitan.
highlights:
Our small-group expedition ensures a seamless adventure. Let us take care of the details, including permits and logistics, so you can fully appreciate the natural wonders surrounding you.

At Good Trip Adventures, our expert guides are not just knowledgeable; they are passionate about Yosemite Valley. From the geological wonders to the unique flora and fauna, they ensure you develop a deeper connection with the valley’s mesmerizing landscapes.
check_in_details: Refer to the designated start time listed when you booked your trip. Your guide will message you 1-2 days in advance to confirm details.
what_to_bring: Reusable water bottle, sunscreen, day pack, layers to adjust to changing temperatures, camera, gratuity for your guide, packed lunch.
special_requirements: They say age is just a number and we (mostly) agree! However, group dynamic considerations, we do have a minimum age of 8 on our small group departures. But there’s no maximum!
restrictions: Participants should comfortably handle a moderate walk of 4-6 miles throughout the day, with moderate elevation changes, to make the most of their adventure.
disclaimers: For an authentic and personalized experience, our small-group tours are limited to 8 guests, and require a minimum of 4 guests to run. You’re welcome to book solo or with a small party. If we fall below the minimum spots booked, registrants can opt for a private tour or receive a full refund—offering flexibility for your adventure plans.
faqs:
Q: What will we see?
A: Yosemite National Park, nestled in the Sierra Nevada mountains of California, is a breathtaking natural wonderland renowned for its towering granite cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and diverse ecosystems. Home to iconic landmark views such as El Capitan, Half Dome, and Yosemite Falls. Throughout the day your group may see stops such as Tunnel View, Bridalveil Falls, the Ansel Adams Gallery, and peer through a spotting scope at rock climbers hanging midway up the face of El Capitan! Alternatively, your group may opt to do a longer day such as Yosemite Falls or Nevada Falls Trail with gorgeous views of the rolling smooth granite mountains and incredible waterfalls.  Along the way, your naturalist guide will share histories of the gold rush, Ahwahneechee people, and give fun facts about the flora and fauna in the area.

Q: Can we adjust the start time or trip length?
A: We will stick to our pickup time and trip length for our small-group tours. For a fully customized trip, we recommend considering our private tour options.

Q: What do we do for lunch?
A: Please pack a lunch to bring with you. Your guide will choose the perfect spot for a scenic picnic. We’ll also have snacks and a selection of beverages available, but feel free to bring along any personal favorites you might crave during the day.

Q: Do I need to tip my guide?
A: Tipping is a common way to say thanks to your guides for all their hard work. While it’s never expected, it’s always appreciated! A good rule of thumb is to tip 10-20% of the total trip cost, split between the guides. Ultimately, the amount is up to you and should reflect the level of service you feel you received. Whatever you choose, the guides will appreciate it!
